name: io.github.notsointresting/frontend-inspo-mcp
title: Frontend Inspo
description: Lets AI agents search and fetch real UI components, frontend code, design tokens and mockups.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Lifts GitHub's 60 requests/hour limit for the GitHub-backed sources. Sent only to api.github.com; a token with no scopes is enough.

environmentVariables.name: FRONTEND_INSPO_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A writable directory for a persistent response cache; without it the cache is in memory only.
